_comment: The Eis tree: trunk of Eisholz, spruce-shaped (pointy) crown of Eisblatt.
trunk_placer:  base_height = minimum trunk height, height_rand_a/b = random extra height.
foliage_placer: radius = how wide the crown is, offset = how far it starts below the top,
trunk_height = how many trunk blocks stay bare at the top.
For a round oak-like crown use: { "type": "minecraft:blob_foliage_placer", "radius": 2, "offset": 0, "height": 3 }
How many trees spawn is set in worldgen/placed_feature/eis_tree.json.
